mapper.sql: select a.article_id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover, a.category_id, c.name as category_name, a.author, a.status, a.is_top, a.view_count, a.word_count, a.reading_time, a.publish_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from cms_article a left join cms_category c on a.category_id = c.category_id

select a.article_id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover, a.content, a.category_id, c.name as category_name, a.author, a.status, a.is_top, a.view_count, a.word_count, a.reading_time, a.publish_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from cms_article a left join cms_category c on a.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.select: order by a.is_top desc, a.publish_time desc, a.article_id desc
select article_id, title, slug from cms_article where slug = #{slug} and del_flag = '0' and article_id <> #{articleId} limit 1
mapper.update:
update cms_article
status = #{status}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where article_id = #{articleId} and del_flag = '0'
update cms_article set del_flag = '2' where article_id in #{id}
update cms_article set view_count = ifnull(view_count, 0) + 1 where article_id = #{articleId} and del_flag = '0'
